english_explanations: a device producing a very narrow and intense beam of light
a concentrated beam of light used in surgery, industry, and communications

chinese_translations.english: a device that produces a narrow, powerful beam of light, or such a beam itself
chinese_translations.example: Surgeons use laser technology to seal small blood vessels without conventional stitches.

english_explanations: a sudden and violent breaking open or explosion
a sudden short period of intense activity or emotion

chinese_translations.english: a sudden breaking apart or explosion of something
chinese_translations.example: A burst in the gas main forced the evacuation of two apartment blocks.

chinese_translations.english: a sudden short spell of intense activity or emotion
chinese_translations.example: The athlete produced a final burst of speed to overtake her rival.

english_explanations: a thick piece of tree trunk cut for fuel or timber
an official written record of events, especially during a journey

chinese_translations.english: a thick unshaped piece of a tree trunk
chinese_translations.example: The carpenter split each log into planks for the new wooden bridge.

chinese_translations.english: an official written record of a journey or of events
chinese_translations.example: The captain entered every course change in the ship's log that night.

english_explanations: a strong feeling of wanting something
a wish to have or do something

chinese_translations.english: a strong feeling of wanting to have or do something
chinese_translations.example: The desire for cleaner air is driving many city councils to expand cycling infrastructure.

english_explanations: a shape like a curve that winds around a central line
a three-dimensional spiral curve, as found in DNA

chinese_translations.english: a shape that curves round and round a central line like a spiral
chinese_translations.example: The double helix of DNA explains how genetic information is copied between generations.

english_explanations: a level of a building
one of the horizontal floors into which a building is divided

chinese_translations.english: a level or floor of a building
chinese_translations.example: The council approved a ten-storey apartment block beside the renovated railway station.

english_explanations: a person who has completed a university degree course
someone who has finished studies at a school or college

chinese_translations.english: a person who has completed a course of study, especially at a university
chinese_translations.example: Graduates in environmental science are in high demand across the renewable energy sector.

english_explanations: to have enough money or time to be able to do or buy something
to provide or give an opportunity or advantage

chinese_translations.meaning: 负担得起；买得起；承担得起
chinese_translations.english: to have enough money or resources for something without causing hardship
chinese_translations.example: Many young families cannot afford housing near the districts with the best schools.

chinese_translations.english: to give or provide an opportunity, view, or protection
chinese_translations.example: The elevated walkway affords visitors a sweeping view of the wetland reserve.

english_explanations: to make someone or something less angry, excited, or worried
to become peaceful and quiet

chinese_translations.english: to make, or become, peaceful and free from strong emotion
chinese_translations.example: Counsellors calmed the anxious candidates shortly before they entered the examination hall.

english_explanations: thin cord made of twisted fibres, used for tying things
a series of connected things, or a wire on a musical instrument

chinese_translations.english: thin cord, or the wire on a musical instrument that produces sound
chinese_translations.example: The physicist compared the vibration of a violin string with the behaviour of light waves.

chinese_translations.english: a series of similar things or events following one another
chinese_translations.example: The journal published a string of papers questioning the original trial methodology.

english_explanations: to change something slightly to make it better or more suitable
to make small changes to the form or quality of something

chinese_translations.english: to change something slightly in order to improve it or make it suitable
chinese_translations.example: Engineers modified the wing design to reduce drag and lower fuel consumption.

chinese_translations.english: to limit or describe the meaning of another word grammatically
chinese_translations.example: In the phrase, the adverb modifies the verb to show how the action was performed.

english_explanations: a collection of historical documents or records kept for reference
the place where such records are stored

chinese_translations.english: a collection of historical records, or the place where they are stored
chinese_translations.example: Colonial archives hold detailed rainfall records that modern climate scientists still consult.

english_explanations: a person who sees an event happen and can describe it
evidence or proof of something, often given in court

chinese_translations.english: a person who sees an event and can describe it, especially in court
chinese_translations.example: The only witness to the collision described the lorry brakes as clearly faulty.

chinese_translations.english: evidence or a sign proving that something exists or happened
chinese_translations.example: The thriving wetland stands as witness to a decade of careful conservation work.
